description: This file is the entry point for a React application. It imports React and ReactDOM, along with CSS styling and the main App component, then renders the App inside the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the application, enabling concurrent mode features.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the root DOM node, initiating the React component tree.
